description_en: This API is used to obtain overview data of quality statistics
description_zh: 本接口用于获取质量统计的概览数据
name: DescribeQualityOverallData

parameters.help_en: The Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The End Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The Metric Types to query, separated by commas (,). Valid values:
JOIN_CHANNEL_SUC_RATE: Channel Join Success Rate.
JOIN_CHANNEL_SUC_FIVE_SEC_RATE: Five-second Channel Join Success Rate.
VIDEO_FIRST_PIC_DUR: Time to First Video Frame.
AUDIO_STUCK_RATE: Audio Lag Rate.
VIDEO_STUCK_RATE: Video Lag Rate.
AUDIO_DELAY: Audio Delay.
VIDEO_DELAY: Video Delay.
AUDIO_HIGH_QUALITY_TRANSMISSION_RATE: Audio High-quality Transmission Rate.
VIDEO_HIGH_QUALITY_TRANSMISSION_RATE: Video High-quality Transmission Rate
parameters.help_zh:
查询的指标类型，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
JOIN_CHANNEL_SUC_RATE：加入频道成功率。
JOIN_CHANNEL_SUC_FIVE_SEC_RATE：五秒加入频道成功率。
VIDEO_FIRST_PIC_DUR：首次出图时间。
AUDIO_STUCK_RATE：音频卡顿率。
VIDEO_STUCK_RATE：视频卡顿率。
AUDIO_DELAY：音频延时。
VIDEO_DELAY：视频延时。
AUDIO_HIGH_QUALITY_TRANSMISSION_RATE：音频优质传输率。
VIDEO_HIGH_QUALITY_TRANSMISSION_RATE：视频优质传输率
parameters.name: types

Average.description_en: The average value of the Metric.

Nodes.description_en: List of coordinate points for the Trend Indicator.
Nodes.description_zh: 指标趋势图坐标点列表

X.description_en: The x-axis coordinate in the Trend Indicator.
X.description_zh: 指标趋势图中x轴横坐标

Y.description_en: The y-axis coordinate in the Trend Indicator
Y.description_zh: 指标趋势图中y轴纵坐标
